map.渠 n=0.013、水力半径 R=0.5、底坡 S=0.001，V=(1/0.0: a channel with n=0.013, hydraulic radius R=0.5 and bed slope S=0.001 gives V=(1/0.013)×0.5^(2/3)×√0.001≈76.92×0.630×0.0316≈1.53 m/s, matching the tool's live calculation.
map.光滑混凝土约 0.012，自然河道 0.03-0.04，乱石 0.05。: About 0.012 for smooth concrete, 0.03-0.04 for natural rivers and 0.05 for rubble.
map.明渠均匀湍流，最常用的河渠公式。: Uniform turbulent flow in open channels; it is the most widely used formula for rivers and canals.
map.曼宁流速：v = (1 ÷ n)·R^(2/3)·√S（m/s，n 糙率、R 水: Manning velocity: v = (1 ÷ n)·R^(2/3)·√S (m/s, n roughness, R hydraulic radius in m, S bed slope); linked values: Chézy coefficient C = R^(1/6) ÷ n, velocity head = v² ÷ (2×9.80665) (m). Validation: n, R and S are guarded as non-empty; n = 0 reports "The denominator cannot be 0" and all-zero input errors. Criteria: no fixed grading; a concrete channel n≈0.013 is a useful order-of-magnitude reference.
